create_json_progress_bar: create a JsonProgressBar instance to log training stats in JSON format
log_intermediate_stats: log intermediate training stats at configured intervals using JsonProgressBar log method
print_epoch_stats: print end-of-epoch stats as JSON using JsonProgressBar print method
format_stats_with_epoch: format stats dictionary with epoch and update info using _format_stats method
rename_logger_context: use rename_logger context manager to temporarily change logger name during logging
